svg.title: Adipocyte
svg.desc: Unilocular adipocyte with one dominant lipid droplet, extremely thin cytoplasmic rim, and peripheral flattened nucleus. Biological basis: White adipocytes store neutral lipid in one large droplet that displaces the nucleus and organelles to the cell periphery.
